This document outlines the inspection checklist for over current and cut off 
 for aux. 11 k.v protection which must be carried out on an annually

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Hatem ahmad Shafea, at 8 July 2008, 
 and accepted by General Manager Eng. Usama Ahmed Hsaneen and approved by Eng. 
 Khalf Alla Mahmod Head 
 Sector of Aswan 
 Dam 1 station HPGC.

items:
A work order must be issued, the 
 maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, shoes
Safety helmet, shoes, and rags
Digital ammeter
Screw driver
Set of secondary injection type DHF
Review technical reference material and manufacture's manual
C.B 11 k.v for this feeder must be off and out
MCB for DC F1 turn off

Disconnect terminal on SPAJ 140c for currants 1-3,4-6, 7-9 and 66 for D.C 
 trip
Prepare secondary injection set and terminal for connection current and time
Connect the currant to 1-3 and time for 66 and 65
MCB for DC F1 turn on
Raise the currant slowly to reach limited currant for trip O.C

Stop injection by Kay for time S1 (S1 off) on set of secondary injection and 
 make time zero on display
Put S1 On
Return step no 9 and record currant and time for trip O.C in the record sheet
Raise the currant slowly to reach limited currant for trip O.C cut off
Stop injection by Kay for time S1 (S1 off) on set of secondary
Put S1 on
Return step no 13 and remark currant and time for O.C cut off
Turn off secondary injection set
Disconnect terminal from 1-3
Connect currant terminal to 4-6
Return steps from 8 to 16
Disconnect terminal from 4-6
Connect currant terminal to 7-9
Return steps from 8 to 16
MCB for DC F1 turn off
Connect terminal 1-3,4-6,7-9 and 65 on SPAJ 140c
Recheck for connection
MCB for DC f1 turn on
